CANTONMENT AREAS UNION COMMITTEES (ZAKATFUND) RULES, 1966
CANTONMENT AREAS UNION COMMITTEES
(ZAKATFUND) RULES, 1966
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, 21st May, 1966]
S.R.O. 462 (K)/66.---In
exercise of the powers conferred by Article 89 of the Basic Democracies Order,
1959 (President's Order 18 of 1955) read with clause (3) of Article 9 thereof,
the Central Government is pleased to make the following rules, namely:---
1. Short title and commencement--(1) These rules may be called the
Cantonment Areas Union Committees (Zakat Fund) Rules,
1966.
(2) They shall come into force at
once.
2. Union Zakat Fund.---Every
Union Committee shall establish -and maintain a separate fund to be known as
the Union Zakat Fund.
3. Constitution of Union Zakat Fund.---(1) Any Muslim pay the Zakat
due from him to Union Committee for credit to the Union Zakat
Fund.
(2) The Zakat
may be paid in cash or kind.
(3) Where the Zakat
is paid in kind and is not required to be utilized as such within a reasonable
time, it may be sold and the sale-proceeds shall be credited to the Union Zakat Fund,
4. Application of the Zakat Fund.---(1)
No part of the Union Zakat Fund shall be applied
except on objects prescribed by the Muslim Personal Law (Shariat).
(2) Subject to the provisions of
sub-rule (1), it shall be lawful for the Government and the Controlling Authority
to issue directions from time to time to the Union Committees and the Union
Committee concerned shall carry out such directions.
5. Scheme for utilizing Zakat Fund.---(1) Without prejudice to the generality of the power
conferred by rule 4, the Union Committee shall frame a scheme or schemes for
the expenditure of the Union Zakat Fund.
(2) The scheme prepared under
sub-rule (1) shall be published in the local area for inviting objections and
suggestions and the final scheme shall be prepared after taking such objections
and suggestions into consideration.
(3) The scheme as finalized under
sub-rule (2) shall be submitted by the Union Committee to the Controlling
Authority for sanction.
(4)
The Controlling Authority may with or without modification sanction or
may refuse to sanction or may return for reconsideration any scheme submitted
to it under sub-rule (3) or may call for such further details or information
about the scheme or may direct such further examination of the scheme as it may
consider necessary
(5) The Union Committee shall
take such steps as may be necessary to implement the scheme as sanctioned by
the Controlling Authority.
6. Accounts.---The Union Committee shall
maintain complete and accurate books of accounts relating to the Union Zakat Fund in the form specified by the Controlling
Authority.
